definitions.explanation: The part that is within or facing inward.

examples.english: There is a lock on the inside of the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内側|うちがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the inside of the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内側|うちがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}ると→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Running on the inside of a curve is faster.

notes:
{内側|うちがわ} refers to the inside, inner surface, or interior of something—the part that faces inward.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {内側|うちがわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open from the inside
- {内側|うちがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to face inward
- {内側|うちがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the inside
- {内側|うちがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go inside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内側|うちがわ}: inside, inner side
- ⟦{外側|そとがわ}→外側：05450_sotogawa⟧: outside, outer side
- ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside, within (more general)
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧: interior (more formal/technical)
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: back side, reverse side

USAGE:
{内側|うちがわ} specifically emphasizes the side or surface facing inward, rather than the space within. Use ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ for referring to the space inside something.
